# RapidJson

**RapidJson** is a fast JSON parser/generator for C++ with both SAX/DOM style API.

## Download Sources & Binaries

- **Site**: https://rapidjson.org/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tencent/rapidjson

## Update Rules

1. Update sources (`src/`).
2. Verify compatibility with the project.
3. Update the README (version, download links, etc).

## Version

1.1.0
